en.headline: Work-week outlook: heavy showers early then turning very hot
en.dek: The Hong Kong Observatory expects occasional heavy showers and thunderstorms on Monday, with the weather becoming brighter later in the week and very hot from Friday onwards.
body: The Hong Kong Observatory’s nine-day forecast indicates that a broad trough of low pressure will continue to bring showers that are heavy at times with squally thunderstorms over the southern China coast on Monday.

From Tuesday the trough is expected to weaken gradually, bringing mainly cloudy conditions with a few showers and some sunny intervals. Temperatures will rise through the week, with very hot weather likely during the day from Friday, when isolated showers and thunderstorms may still occur.

A tropical cyclone over the western North Pacific is forecast to edge closer to the East China Sea later in the week, with its outer subsiding air contributing to the hotter conditions. Residents are advised to stay updated on the latest warnings as heavy rain remains possible early in the week.

zh.headline: 本周天氣預報：初段有大驟雨其後轉酷熱
zh.dek: 天文台預料周一仍有大驟雨及雷暴，其後天氣逐漸轉為明亮，周五起日間酷熱。
body: 香港天文台九天天氣預報顯示，寬廣低壓槽周一繼續為華南沿岸帶來間中大驟雨及狂風雷暴。
周二起低壓槽逐漸減弱，本港大致多雲，有幾陣驟雨及部分時間有陽光。氣溫本周逐漸回升，周五起日間酷熱，仍有局部地區驟雨及雷暴。
西北太平洋一個熱帶氣旋預料本周後期靠近東海一帶，其外圍下沉氣流有助帶來酷熱天氣。市民應留意最新天氣警告，本周初仍可能有大雨。
